The disease occurs in males and females equally, without familial clustering, and often affects multiple contiguous bones unilaterally in an asymmetric distribution2. Symptoms of melorheostosis may begin in childhood; the diagnosis is usually apparent by the age of 20 years3. Patients were excluded if pregnant or lactating, if under the age of 18, if actively infected or if unable to provide informed consent. Study subjects were not compensated for their participation.
